UpdateAutoscalerConfigurationV2.clusterID: The ID of an existing cluster.
UpdateAutoscalerConfigurationV2.expander: Node group selection strategy for autoscaling. Valid values: random, most-pods, least-waste, priority. Default: random.
UpdateAutoscalerConfigurationV2.instanceGroups: Autoscaler configuration for node groups. No user input required.
UpdateAutoscalerConfigurationV2.kubeVersion: Kubernetes version. If left empty, the backend will automatically query the cluster's Kubernetes version.
UpdateAutoscalerConfigurationV2.maxEmptyBulkDelete: Maximum number of concurrent scale-down operations.
UpdateAutoscalerConfigurationV2.scaleDownDelayAfterAdd: Delay before scale-down starts after a scale-up event, in minutes.
UpdateAutoscalerConfigurationV2.scaleDownEnabled: Whether to enable scale-down. Default: false.
UpdateAutoscalerConfigurationV2.scaleDownGPUUtilizationThreshold: GPU utilization threshold percentage for scale-down, range: (0, 100).
UpdateAutoscalerConfigurationV2.scaleDownUnneededTime: Delay before triggering scale-down, in minutes.
UpdateAutoscalerConfigurationV2.scaleDownUtilizationThreshold: CPU/memory utilization threshold percentage for scale-down, range: (0, 100).
UpdateAutoscalerConfigurationV2.skipNodesWithLocalStorage: Whether to skip nodes using local storage. Default: true.
UpdateAutoscalerConfigurationV2.skipNodesWithSystemPods: Whether to skip nodes running system pods. Default: true.
